The Wall Street Journal feed describes Nvidia-supported data centers in Southeast Asia providing Chinese companies with access to advanced computing under a gap in US restrictions. It also refers to alleged chip smuggling, which is a separate claim from remote access to chips outside China.

The article body was inaccessible, so this entry cannot verify the arrangements, applicable rules or alleged transfers. Neither use of a regulatory gap nor the feed’s framing establishes personal wrongdoing by Huang.
highlights: Remote compute access differs from chip shipment
Southeast Asian facilities are the stated subject
Full legal and factual context unavailable
